title: AI and ML Taxonomy in Healthcare
description: Interactive Venn diagram illustrating the hierarchical relationship between Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and Deep Learning in healthcare contexts. Shows nested subsets where Deep Learning is contained within Machine Learning, which is contained within Artificial Intelligence.
subject: Healthcare Data Science
creator: Claude AI with Venn Diagram Generator Skill
learningObjectives: Explain the nested subset relationship Deep Learning is contained in Machine Learning is contained in Artificial Intelligence
Distinguish rule-based AI such as expert systems and knowledge graphs from Machine Learning approaches that learn from data
Classify healthcare applications such as clinical decision support, outcome prediction, and medical imaging analysis into the AI, ML, or DL ring where they belong
Explain why Deep Learning's multi-layer neural networks demand larger datasets than broader AI approaches
Evaluate which technology level fits a given healthcare data problem
